description: On-device probe of os_log/logcat chunking with messages that cross chunk budgets mid-code-point: emoji, CJK, and the Android modified-UTF-8 two-byte NUL. Verify no code point is split and no bytes are lost or duplicated across chunks, reading the actual device log output. Positive control: a deliberately mis-budgeted build must fail the verifier. Runs in the probes2 harness against packaged --dev false bundles.
title: Console-chunking probe at multi-byte boundaries (iOS + Android)
